text: We wrote and hash-sealed the criterion before the evidence harvest. It admitted dynamical pulsar timing masses. It also required an uncontested double-neutron star system. This kept the thresholds from following the answer. After sealing, we found the source's own, he-read-giant caveat. We did not narrow the rule. The source calls that shift small, but gives no number. The 19.3% difference remains nearly 5 times the 4% threshold. The verdict is unchanged.
